html:
Enver Hoxha was the communist ruler of Albania from 1944 until his death in 1985, born in 1908 in Gjirokastër in the south.

A former teacher who had studied in France, he led the communist Partisans to power in World War II and built one of the harshest dictatorships in Europe, with labour camps, executions and a secret police, the Sigurimi. He broke with Yugoslavia in 1948, with the Soviet Union in 1961 and with China in 1978, leaving Albania alone. He declared it the world's first atheist state in 1967, closing every mosque and church. He brought electricity and schooling to the whole country, but it stayed the poorest in Europe. His fear of invasion produced the bunkers that still dot the land.
sum: Enver Hoxha was the communist ruler of Albania from 1944 until his death in 1985, born in 1908 in Gjirokastër in the south.
